data.description:
## Incident Overview

The provenance pipeline sees all implementation commits as unprovenanced. DSO-Story-Merge: trailers are on empty recovery commits with no file diffs. Implementation commits carry DSO-Story: (task attribution), not DSO-Story-Merge: (story merge). Integration review reviews the full diff instead of the cross-branch subset.

**Impact**: Full diff reviews lead to more findings, higher token usage, and more frequent blocking.
**Related**: bug e349 (known gap in ci-pr trailer injection)
data.title: ci-llm-review: DSO-Story-Merge trailers on empty recovery commits -> full diff reviewed
